config.method: selects training examples by alignment between weak labels and strong-model embedding geometry, then fine-tunes on the top-scoring half

summary: Scoring training examples by how well their weak labels align with the strong model's frozen embedding geometry, using probe predictability, neighbor smoothness, local density, and entropy signals, then fine-tuning only on the top half of examples by this composite score, this approach reached a PGR of 0.75 on the chat preference testbed.
source: Wen, Qiu, et al., 'Automated Weak-to-Strong Researcher', Anthropic Alignment Science Blog, 2026
